visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal carousel of portrait (9:16) video cards with poster, play icon and title overlay; clicking a card opens the video in a fullscreen modal player; prev/next arrows and a progress bar
visualCharacteristics.description: White background. Header row: H3 left, outlined pill CTA right. Carousel of 5 portrait (9:16) video cards, poster image + play icon + white title overlay at bottom; click opens a fullscreen video player.

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: poster image. Cell 2: title (H5) and a link to the MP4 video. Non-video links fall back to normal navigation. Variant body text: poster, video link, heading (headline), plain paragraphs (body)
contentPattern.description: Carousel of 5 video cards (poster, title, MP4): Will not burn**, Engineered for Climate(R), Creating possibilities, Leading transformation, Holds little appeal for pests | Portrait 9:16 poster cards with play icon and title overlay; each slide links an MP4 that opens fullscreen
